symptom: An allowlist entry without a trailing slash admits a sibling-prefix output path (e.g. reports/n2-escape/record.json for reports/n2), and an exact-file allowlist admits a filename with an appended suffix.
lesson: String startsWith is not a path-component boundary. Research write-scope allowlists should not accept a sibling directory or filename merely because it shares the same textual prefix.
guardrail: Match an exact allowlisted path or a child path only after a directory separator; cover trailing-slash and no-trailing-slash allowlist entries, exact-file suffixes, and multi-output batches. Preserve existing path-traversal and absolute-path rejection, and require full repository CI before promotion.
